Clean and Standardize Seurat Dimensional Reductions

Source: R/Processing.R
CleanSeuratReductions.Rd

Automatically detects, renames, and rebuilds dimensional reductions within a Seurat object to ensure they comply with Seurat's strict internal naming conventions. It converts reduction names containing dots or underscores (e.g., "pca.log") into standard camelCase (e.g., "pcaLog"). Crucially, it extracts the raw matrices and completely rebuilds the DimReduc object to guarantee that the internal key and the column names of both the embeddings and loadings correctly match the new name.

Usage

CleanSeuratReductions(seurat_obj)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object containing one or more dimensional reductions.

Value

An updated Seurat object where all dimensional reductions have been cleanly renamed and rebuilt. The old misnamed reductions are safely removed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Inspect current reduction names (e.g., "pca.log", "umap_integration")
Reductions(my_seurat)

# Clean and rebuild all reductions
my_seurat <- CleanSeuratReductions(my_seurat)

# Inspect the new names (e.g., "pcaLog", "umapIntegration")
Reductions(my_seurat)
} # }
